description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Booking details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PreTravelReminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Booking details" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Start_BookingDetails" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PreTravelReminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Start_PreTravelReminder" messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket booking and journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer begins ticket search"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select preferred route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel feedback or services?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Journey" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide feedback or use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PostTravel" name="Post-travel follow-up completed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PreTravelReminder" name="Receive pre-travel reminders and instructions" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PreTravelReminder" name="Pre-travel reminders or instructions received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PreTravelReminder" messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PreTravelReminder" name="Reminders or instructions received"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreTravelReminder" sourceRef="Start_PreTravelReminder" targetRef="End_PreTravelReminder"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_Yes" name="Feedback or services extend the process" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_No" name="No post-travel follow-up" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="End_Journey"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_End" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="End_PostTravel"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company ticket processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BookingDetails" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingDetails" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Booking system generates ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer by email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder" name="Send pre-travel reminders or instructions?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoReminder" name="Booking processing completed without reminders"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReminderSent" name="Booking processing completed after reminders"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="Start_BookingDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Yes" name="Reminders or instructions sent" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder" targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_No" name="No reminders or instructions sent" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder" targetRef="End_NoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_End" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="End_ReminderSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
